description: Replace the linear no-progress/dead-pane retry backoff in the supervisor loop with exponential backoff plus +/-20% jitter.

userStories.title: Exponential-with-jitter retry backoff in the supervisor loop
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need the no-progress and dead-pane retry backoff to grow exponentially with +/-20% jitter (BASE 60s, MAX 300s) instead of linearly, so that longer rate-limit windows and transient crash bursts get a wider clearance window and multiple concurrent instances do not re-dispatch in lockstep (thundering herd).
acceptanceCriteria: A pure, unit-tested helper in src/supervisor/loop.ts computes the retry interval as min(MAX_BACKOFF_MS, BASE_BACKOFF_MS * 2^(streak-1)) and then applies +/-20% jitter derived from an injected random source (deterministic in tests). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]
Constants for the base (60_000 ms), the max cap (300_000 ms), and the jitter fraction (0.2) are defined in src/supervisor/loop.ts. [oracle: grep -Eq 'MAX_BACKOFF_MS' src/supervisor/loop.ts]

Both retry sites (dead-worker at the pane-died/timeout branch and no-progress at the re-confirmed-story branch) route the sleepFn(...) argument AND the emitted backoffMs event field through the new helper; no linear `* streak` backoff multiplication remains in the code paths. [oracle: bash -c '! grep -Eq "BACKOFF_MS \* (deadWorkerStreak|noProgressStreak)" src/supervisor/loop.ts']

An injectable randomFn (default Math.random) is added to RunSupervisorOptions so jitter is deterministic under test; the emitted backoffMs equals the value passed to sleepFn at each site. [oracle: grep -q 'randomFn' src/supervisor/loop.ts]

The existing backoff assertions in test/supervisor/loop.test.ts (the sleeps arrays and the pane-died-retry / no-progress-retry backoffMs event fields) are updated to inject a deterministic randomFn and assert the exponential+jitter values. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]

The sleepFn injectable seam is preserved: tests still capture non-zero sleeps via the injected no-op sleepFn (paired with a small pollIntervalMs to avoid CPU spin). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]

The file-size ratchet is honored: if src/supervisor/loop.ts or test/supervisor/loop.test.ts exceed their ceilings in scripts/file-size-budget.json, the ceilings are raised with a CAM-85 tracker ref in the _ref field, and bun run check:all passes. [oracle: bun run check:all]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: Single-concern mechanical change, all in src/supervisor/loop.ts + its test. CALL SITES: dead-worker backoff at ~line 903 (emit 'pane-died-retry' backoffMs) and ~line 906 (sleepFn); no-progress backoff at ~line 1106 (emit 'no-progress-retry' backoffMs) and ~line 1109 (sleepFn). Constants block: ~lines 445-473 (MAX_NO_PROGRESS_RETRIES, NO_PROGRESS_BACKOFF_MS=60_000, MAX_DEAD_WORKER_RETRIES). RunSupervisorOptions type: ~lines 200-260 (add randomFn next to sleepFn/nowMs; default Math.random). Prefer a pure helper e.g. computeBackoffMs(streak, { base, max, jitterFraction, random }) and unit-test it directly. GOTCHA 1 (issue is WRONG): the issue says 'a mudanca e segura sem tocar nos testes existentes' but test/supervisor/loop.test.ts DOES assert exact sleep values (expect(sleeps).toEqual([NO_PROGRESS_BACKOFF_MS*1, NO_PROGRESS_BACKOFF_MS*2]) at lines 341/375/581) and exact backoffMs (lines 346/586). You MUST update these; inject randomFn to make jitter deterministic (e.g. () => 0.5 -> zero jitter offset if jitter is centered, or a fixed fraction) and recompute expected values. GOTCHA 2 (surgical scope): keep MAX_NO_PROGRESS_RETRIES and MAX_DEAD_WORKER_RETRIES at 3 (NOT in the acceptanceCriteria; the '~6 min / 3 retries' line in the issue body is a loose suggestion, not settled scope). Consequence: only streaks 1 and 2 ever reach the sleep before the cap blocks at streak 3, and 2^(streak-1) = 1,2 equals the old linear multiplier for those two streaks; MAX_BACKOFF_MS (300s) never binds at 60s/120s. So the observable change at the current cap is the jitter; the exponential base only matters if a future story raises the retry cap. Keep the docstrings at lines 447-471 accurate (they currently describe the linear 180s-total math). GOTCHA 3 (file-size ratchet): src/supervisor/loop.ts is 1602/1603 and test/supervisor/loop.test.ts is 3094/3094 in scripts/file-size-budget.json (both at ceiling). Adding the helper/constants/seam and the test updates will exceed both; raise the ceilings with a CAM-85 _ref entry (ratchet raise-and-retry pattern in scripts/cam/patterns.md 'Ratchet gate pattern' and 'cam-ship Step 3 ratchet raise-and-retry'). PATTERN: keep the test's 'if (ms > 0) sleeps.push(ms)' shape and pair the no-op sleepFn with a tiny pollIntervalMs (see patterns.md 'Test timeout with no-op sleepFn'). noUncheckedIndexedAccess is on; guard any array/regex access. No external library, no vendor/, no templates/, no Ink screen touched.
